params.body:
First screen of the per-screen rebuild: the settings screen (index, header, all eleven panes) rendered with Tailwind utilities and a few small `ui-` components instead of Bootstrap grid/nav-tabs/form-control and the refresh.css rules that patched them. Behaviour unchanged: every id, name, hidden input, form action, Alpine `tab` value and pane id is the same, so `?tab=N` deep links and the scripts on the page keep working.

**Layout**
- Tab bar (`ui-tabs`): text with an icon, the active one underlined in blue; the "Service" dropdown (transport / verlengde waarborg) kept. On phones the tabs become a horizontally scrollable row of chips (icon + name, active filled, scroll snap), so the neighbours stay visible; no dropdown-looking box.
- Every pane: one column on phones with 12px gaps, label above field, every field full width, save button full width at the end (`ui-form-grid`, `ui-form-actions`); two columns from 768px where the pane had them.
- Showroom: link as a readable field with Openen and Kopieer under it on phones (beside it on desktop), interval with its unit attached, the toggle as a switch with its label, download button with its hint as field help.
- New components: `x-ui.switch` (hidden 0 + checkbox 1, locked variant for accepted consents, the same posting shape the controllers read) and `x-ui.affix` (unit or sign attached to a field, slot for a select prefix). Toggle list (`ui-toggle-list`), copy link, radio with description, native file input styled, compact list for the transport tables.
- Real Garant pane: partner logo on its dark tile, active/inactive badge, the info link as a named link "Verschil tussen de formules (pdf)" like on the detail page.

**refresh.css**: 4517 to 4563 lines. Removed the settings-only rules (`.ui-settings` input-group widths, the `.ui-settings` halves of the tab rules, the website options block, the old copy-link block, `.ui-option-order-actions`); added the component rules above in one block. Net +46 lines because the components did not exist yet; they serve every screen that follows.

**Classes kept for JS or CSS hooks** (grepped): `.background_image` + `.remove_button` (remove script on the page, sass), `.pdf_attachment` + `.remove_button` (idem), `.searchform` (theme JS), `.price_input`, `.switch` on the transport checkboxes, `.on_stock_switch` on the range switch, `.hide` on the AI box (script toggles it), `.tab-pane` + `active` on panes, `#font-picker`/`#website_font`, `.warranty-tip` (sass). The `$('.select2').select2()` line in the page script is untouched.

**Left as it was**: the "Showroomaffiche" pane (option ordering): jQuery UI sortable selects `div.row:not(.unsortable)` and reads the row ids, so its Bootstrap rows stay; only its heading and action row use the shared classes. "Locaties" was already Tailwind.

**Noted, not changed**: in the Real Garant contact block the field names and labels are crossed (`warranty_contact_phone` labelled e-mail and the other way round); the controller reads by name, so it is kept as it was and marked in a comment. The AI pane had a dead `@if(1 == 2)` block (ai_dealer_real_garant) that never rendered; dropped.

Checks: `npm run build`, StylesheetSyntaxTest and BuildContractTest green, `view:cache` compiles. CI renders /settings in the smoke test. CLAUDE.md not touched (another agent is on it): the two components deserve a line under "UI messages (one vocabulary)".
params.title: Settings screen in Tailwind (first screen of the rebuild)
